name: Morobe Digital Government Project - MMU
developer: Morobe Provincial Government / PNG DataCo / Oracle
notes: Cloud/digital-infrastructure project for Morobe government announced in March 2026, with DataCo and Oracle providing cloud applications, digital infrastructure and platform services. NBC later reported Datec's sovereign data-centre solutions roadshow in Lae on 2026-06-13. No standalone Morobe physical data-center building or capacity was confirmed.

name: PNG DataCo Madang CLS
notes: Listed as a Madang cable landing station and secondary data center/disaster recovery site for PNG DataCo, serving PPC-1 and Kumul Submarine Cable Network connectivity. DataCenterMap country page lists Papua New Guinea markets as Port Moresby and Madang only.

name: PNG DataCo Primary Data Centre
notes: PNG DataCo official service page describes secure rack space in PNG's premier Tier 3 data center with ISO-certified environment, redundant power and cooling, 24/7 monitoring, DR hosting, and local sovereign hosting. DataCenterMap country page lists Port Moresby as one of two PNG data-center markets.

name: Datec PNG Port Moresby
notes: Inflect lists a Port Moresby data center on Poreporena Freeway operated by Datec PNG Ltd, offering colocation through cabinets and private cages. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Papua New Guinea Sovereign AI Data Centre
notes: Kumul Consolidated Holdings reported the official pre-launch on 2026-03-30. Facility is intended for high-performance computing, AI workloads, secure cloud adoption, and advanced analytics while keeping national data hosted in Papua New Guinea. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Papua New Guinea government Huawei-built data centre
developer: Government of Papua New Guinea / Huawei
notes: DCD reported on 2020-08-12 that Huawei built a PNG government data center in Port Moresby, funded by a US$53m Chinese state loan and opened in 2018, but with serious security and maintenance issues. Kept as operational because the facility existed and some departments had moved in, though reports said most had not and a rebuild may be required.

name: Bank of South Pacific data and operations centres
notes: RPS project page says it managed design and delivery of a data centre and disaster recovery centre for Bank of South Pacific in Port Moresby, two business-critical data infrastructure facilities with N+2 redundancy, through commissioning, handover and defects-liability completion. Project value about PGK170m/AUD85m; capacity not disclosed.
